en: A vintage sepia postcard depicting a cobbled street bordered by rows of old European houses, with people in period clothing (adults and children) standing, walking, or playing on the street. There is a horse-drawn carriage and an electric tram or streetcar visible on the tracks in the road. Some trees line the street. The style appears to be typical of late 19th or early 20th century Europe.
